Bob the Builder Bob the Builder was a DUPLO and Explore licensed theme based on the British children's television series of the same name by HiT Entertainment (currently known as Mattel Television) and Keith Chapman. The theme ran for… Brick Runners Brick Runners was a theme introduced in 1999, however no 2000 sets were made. LEGO brought back Brick Runners for 2002, for its Explore line, but discontinued it until 2009, when it was re-released one final time. Dora the Explorer Dora the Explorer was a popular children's show that debuted in 2000. In 2004 LEGO manufactured Dora the Explorer Explore sets, but the theme was short lived and discontinued by the end of the year.
